list.name: run
list.label: Run
list.query: SELECT 'All' AS __text, 'All' AS __value UNION ALL (SELECT run_id, run_id FROM runs ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50)

panels.title: Incidents by terminal phase and reason

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(i.terminal_phase,'(open)') AS phase, coalesce(i.reason,'') AS reason, count(*) AS incidents FROM incidents i WHERE ($__timeFilter(i.detected_at)) AND ('${run}' = 'All' OR i.run_id = '${run}') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

SELECT g.stage::text AS stage, count(*) FILTER (WHERE g.verdict='pass') AS pass, count(*) FILTER (WHERE g.verdict='fail') AS fail FROM gate_decisions g JOIN incidents i USING (incident_uid) WHERE ($__timeFilter(i.detected_at)) AND ('${run}' = 'All' OR i.run_id = '${run}') GROUP BY g.stage ORDER BY g.stage

panels.title: Actions (intent, request, Audit-Id)

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.intent_at AS "time", i.target, a.action_id, a.action_class, a.http_status, a.result, a.audit_id, a.idempotency_key FROM actions a JOIN incidents i USING (incident_uid) WHERE ($__timeFilter(a.intent_at)) AND ('${run}' = 'All' OR i.run_id = '${run}') ORDER BY a.intent_at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.description: One row per action. The row exists before the request (write-ahead); audit_id joins it to the API Audit Log.

panels.title: Incomplete actions (intent without an Audit-Id)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS incomplete FROM actions a JOIN incidents i USING (incident_uid) WHERE a.audit_id IS NULL AND a.intent_at < now() - interval '1 minute' AND ($__timeFilter(a.intent_at)) AND ('${run}' = 'All' OR i.run_id = '${run}')

panels.description: Reconciliation flags these. Zero is expected: an intent row whose request was never completed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.at AS "time", i.target, v.criteria_id, v.result, v.observations::text AS observations FROM verifications v JOIN incidents i USING (incident_uid) WHERE ($__timeFilter(v.at)) AND ('${run}' = 'All' OR i.run_id = '${run}') ORDER BY v.at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT i.detected_at AS "time", i.target, p.reasoner_mode, p.model_id, p.schema_valid, p.fallback_used, p.latency_ms FROM proposals p JOIN incidents i USING (incident_uid) WHERE ($__timeFilter(i.detected_at)) AND ('${run}' = 'All' OR i.run_id = '${run}') ORDER BY i.detected_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT t.at AS "time", i.target, t.incident_uid, t.seq, t.from_phase, t.to_phase, t.stage, t.reason FROM transitions t JOIN incidents i USING (incident_uid) WHERE ($__timeFilter(t.at)) AND ('${run}' = 'All' OR i.run_id = '${run}') ORDER BY t.at DESC, t.seq DESC LIMIT 300
